Vendors / Apply

Apply to vend with Move Mountains.

Tell us about your business and which venues you would like to set up at. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Before you apply

Our markets run monthly across three rotating venues in the Austin and Manor area. Standard 10x10 tents are most common. Vendors are responsible for their own setup, signage, and supplies. We follow up on every application within 7 business days.

If you sell food, please make sure you can provide your county permit and food manager certification before your first market.

If you can do multiple venues, leave this on No preference and tell us in the notes.

Booth shares are allowed when both vendors apply. Put your booth-share partner's email here.

We reply within 7 business days. Questions? Email info@movemountainsmarket.com.

Thank you. Your vendor application is in. We will review and follow up by email within 7 business days.
